title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 03, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.8 (Peaked November 03, 2026 at 06:15 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 360 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Satellites have some energetic company right now! 🛰💡🌞

A broad coronal-hole-like region stands out today alongside several bright active-region loops; visible sunspots remain sparse.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
